name: AI Strategy 2019 (AI戦略2019)
owner: Cabinet Secretariat & Cabinet Office, Japan (内閣官房 / 内閣府)
description: AI Strategy 2019: AI for Everyone — People, Industries, Regions and Governments (June 11, 2019). National artificial intelligence strategy and statutory AI Basic Plan formulated by Japan's Integrated Innovation Strategy Promotion Council / AI Strategy Council in the Cabinet Office (内閣府), setting national priorities across AI safety, economic security, compute and foundation model infrastructure, talent development, and Society 5.0.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Cabinet Secretariat & Cabinet Office, Japan (内閣官房 / 内閣府) (cas.go.jp) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Cabinet Secretariat & Cabinet Office, Japan (内閣官房 / 内閣府) (cas.go.jp).
